course.title: Executive Threat Assessment and Protective Intelligence
course.audience: Corporate security teams, executive support personnel, and protection professionals
course.description: An original Obserra Academy advanced course focused on threat assessment, evidence calibration, protective planning, and escalation. It uses practical decision scenarios, knowledge checks, and accountable application rather than third-party certification material.
outcomes: Frame threat assessment, evidence calibration, protective planning, and escalation in business context.
Evaluate evidence and uncertainty before acting.
Apply policy, authority, and proportionate escalation.
